title: Zoning text change for affordable housing at 135-27 Sapphire Street, Queens
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 135-27 Sapphire Street in Queens. It works together with a related zoning map change to allow a new six-story residential building of about 186,380 square feet with roughly 268 apartments, about 67 of them permanently income-restricted. The Council approved the measure on October 22, 2026.
